systems.system: Biometric national identity card issuance system, with a central AFIS
systems.platform: IRIS (Malaysia), with Synapsys Conseil; proprietary biometric templates
systems.owner: Direction de l'Automatisation des Fichiers (DAF), Ministère de l'Intérieur
systems.tiers: Applications taken and ten fingerprints captured in the country's commissariats, each with a local database, encrypted and transferred to the central site in Dakar; in service since October 2016, about 7,300,000 cards issued by April 2019

systems.system: Biometric passport issuance system, with a central AFIS
systems.owner: Direction de la Police des Etrangers et des Titres de Voyage (DPETV), Ministère de l'Intérieur
systems.tiers: Applications taken in commissariats and sent to the central site in Dakar; 4 autonomous issuing centres print locally; 138,423 passports issued from October 2016 to April 2019

systems.system: Web gateway from the passport system to the identity card database
systems.tiers: DPETV; search by identity card number, unique identifier or birth certificate number, not by biometrics

systems.platform: paper, not machine-readable; a chip-card modernisation under study, not operational

note: A feasibility study of identity files: the commissariats appear only as enrolment points for identity cards and passports. It says nothing of how a station records a complaint or a case, so no fact of class record.
